messages:
Maya: Heads-up — support ticket #5248: customer reports p99 spike for /v1/generate in eu-west starting ~10:20Z, they're seeing 2.3–3s responses (was ~400ms).
Devon: ack, any deploys around that time?
oncall-bot: Deploy finished by Sam (canary) at 2026-03-17T10:19:40Z — runtime-optimizations:v2 -> 3 hosts in eu-west
Maya: yep that canary. attaching mini timeline and logs.
SupportAgent: customer provided curl repro, said intermittent but consistent for 10:20-10:35.
Sam: confirming — canary started 10:19. I see error budget burn on eu-west. pulling traces now.
Alex: looking at Grafana: p95 went from 140ms -> 360ms, p99 from 520ms -> 2500ms in the same window. CPU on the serving nodes spiked and headroom dropped.
Devon: possible cold K/V cache churn with new runtime kernels. check kv cache hit ratio and batch sizes.
Sam: kv cache hit-rate dropped from 96% -> 42% after canary. double-checked model variant unchanged.
Maya: immediate mitigations we can try: 1) throttle canary traffic 2) flip canary out (rollback) 3) route heavy customers to fallback model in other region 4) enable circuit breaker for requests >600ms
Devon: I'll open quick rate-limit to protect control plane: `/admin/rate-limits` patch. command: 
```
curl -X POST https://admin.redwood/_internal/rl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN' -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","region":"eu-west","limit_per_min":4500}'
```
Sam: also rolling back canary now — `kubectl rollout undo deployment/serve-runtime -n eu-west --to-revision=stable`
oncall-bot: Rollout undo started by Sam at 2026-03-17T10:28:05Z — status: in_progress
Alex: while rollback proceeds, we should open a fast fallback route for enterprise customers: route to small-quant model in us-east as a proxy. Sam — can you add routing rule?
Sam: added routing override for customer account 453 via admin routing API: 
```
POST https://admin.redwood/routing/override
{
  "account": "453",
  "route": "/v1/generate",
  "fallback": {"model": "redwood-mistral-7b-q4", "region":"us-east"},
  "priority": "high"
}
```
Devon: also enabling circuit breaker guard at proxy level to fail fast when backend p99 > 1s: `cb.set('/v1/generate', {window:60,threshold_ms:1000,consec:3})` — will open to partial traffic only.
Maya: nice. Sam — once rollback finishes, please confirm kv cache warmup metrics and re-run small load test for the ticket's repro.
Sam: rollback complete at 10:33Z. kv cache hit-rate back to 94% within 90s. running synthetic repro from eu-west now.
SupportAgent: customer verified degraded requests decreased, says still saw one slow request ~1.5s at 10:34 but then recovered.
Alex: we should add an SLO guard: automatic throttling threshold at p99 > 800ms for 2m => trigger circuit breaker + routing fallback. file a follow-up.
Devon: note for postmortem: root cause likely runtime kernel interaction with cache eviction pattern on small canary cohort. need stress test for kernel+cache combos.
Maya: action items: 1) Sam to open PR to add canary warmup + gradual traffic ramp 2) Dev to add SLO guard rules and automated CB + routing policy 3) Alex to draft incident note for support + customer communication 4) SupportAgent to follow up with customer and confirm resolution.
Sam: PR created #789, will include warmup and kv prefill hook.
oncall-bot: Incident closed as mitigated at 2026-03-17T10:37:10Z — postmortem pending. :white_check_mark:
Maya: thanks team. leaving this thread open for PM/infra follow-ups.
